files.content:
# MediPulse Application

A hospital data-management web app that replaces paper registers with one searchable record of patients, doctors, nurses and support staff.

## Architecture
- `src/components/App.tsx` - self-contained React + Tailwind single-page app (types, themes, helpers, seed data, views).
- `src/types/index.ts` - exported interfaces for documentation.
- `tests/app.test.ts` - Bun unit tests for filtering, occupancy, admission IDs and status transitions.

## Features
- Hero dashboard with live KPIs (patients, critical cases, bed occupancy, staff on duty).
- Four views: Dashboard, Patients, Staff Directory, Settings.
- Search plus multi-parameter filtering (status, department, role) built with pill chips.
- Patient detail modal: vitals, status changes, doctor assignment, clinical notes.
- Three-step admission drawer with validation and confirmation ID.
- Staff duty toggle switches, staff photos with fallback avatars.
- Four themes (Clinical Blue, Midnight Ward, Emerald Care, Rose Daylight).
- localStorage persistence guarded by an `isHydrated` flag; toast feedback on every action.

## Commands
```
bun install
bun run dev
bun run build
bun test
```
